title: how-it-works says any DHW sensor, volume or window activates hot water; the wizard's explicit switch overrides that
claim: docs/how-it-works.md:303-305 says 'hot water optimization activates as soon as any one of a DHW temperature sensor, a tank volume or a set of demand windows is configured', but thermal_model:_dhw_enabled_from_config returns the explicit dhw_enabled switch whenever the entry carries it, and the setup wizard's Hot water step writes it (unticked by default), so on such an entry all 7 non-empty configurations of the presence trio leave hot water off.
mechanism: The presence trio is the fallback for entries without the explicit switch (pre-switch entries); the switch (configuration.md's 'The house has a hot water tank', default unticked) was added later and the how-it-works sentence still states the fallback as the rule. A user who adds a tank sensor on the options page expecting hot water planning to start sees none until the box is ticked.

evidence.contention_note: box heavily loaded (load1 ~200); counts are contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb: the resolver's explicit-switch branch removed in memory (presence trio only)

null_control.note: on an entry without the explicit switch the documented presence rule holds; the gap is only the switch's

metric_definition: Presence-trio configurations (7 non-empty subsets) the doc says activate hot water that the production resolver leaves off on an entry carrying dhw_enabled=False.
phenomenon_property: The reader documents state the hot-water activation rule the resolver implements: the explicit switch when present, the presence trio otherwise.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D5/s2/dhw_enable.py; grep -n -i 'activates as soon as\|has a hot water tank' README.md docs/*.md
proposed_fix_scope: Rewrite how-it-works.md:303-305: hot water is planned when 'The house has a hot water tank' is ticked; an entry created before that switch existed infers it from a DHW sensor, tank volume or demand windows. For D6: the sentence's truth.
